text:
alex: kicking off nrt1 GPU cluster bring-up. goal is a small pilot pool (8 GPUs) for model validation and latency profiling. Im starting the validation checklist now, dropping notes here for handoff.

maya: copying checklist items into thread. will run infra smoke then app smoke.

raj: quick note — using a mixed pool: 6 prod-rated A100s + 2 preemptible T4s for burst. keep preemptible under canary so eviction doesn't affect SLOs.

samir: got it. posting prep commands I ran to verify networking:
```
# node discovery
kubectl get nodes -l region=nrt1 -o wide
# check kubelet and taints
kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}: {.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].status}
'
```

ioana: infra smoke checklist (executed in order):
- [ ] node image & driver versions match golden AMI (cuda=12.1, nvidia-driver=535.x)
- [ ] MIG config applied on A100s where required
- [ ] local NVMe mount healthy (fio sanity)
- [ ] MTU=9000 set on interface and tested with iperf3 (p95 < 2ms to gateway)
- [ ] BGP peer up to cloud-edge (no route flaps last 1h)
- [ ] firewall rules: control plane ports + health probe ports (10250, 3000, 8080) open
- [ ] images pullable from internal registry (auth via vault token)

alex: adding SLO gate numbers for this pilot (must pass to move to canary):
- control-plane pod start p95 < 30s
- GPU allocation success rate >= 99.5% over 1h
- model-serving p50 < 40ms for small prompts, p95 < 200ms under 10 concurrent requests
- inter-node packet loss < 0.1%
- disk IOPS baseline within 10% of expected (fio read/write)

maya: app smoke checklist (run after infra smoke):
- [ ] pull latest runtime image and start test server
- [ ] load runtime with small model (7B) -> full inference end-to-end
- [ ] KV cache warmup: validate prefix caching works (cache hit rate > 60% on synthetic set)
- [ ] streaming path test (client disconnects) -> no leaked sessions
- [ ] rate-limiter check: 429s handled gracefully by fallback route

raj: cost & capacity notes:
- expected hourly run rate for this pilot ~ $14/hr (A100s) + $1/hr for T4s; watch cloud billing dashboard during the 24h canary
- if spot eviction > 2 per 24h, raise to 0% preemptible for the pool

samir: running automated health probes now — posting quick logs:
```
[10:12:03] node-nrt1-a: kubelet Ready=true, driver=535.54, cuda=12.1
[10:12:05] node-nrt1-b: kubelet Ready=true, driver=535.54, cuda=12.1
[10:12:10] nvlink: all links up, no ECC errors
```

ioana: networking smoke: iperf3 from worker to egress gateway: p50=0.8ms, p95=1.9ms, jitter=0.2ms — good.

deploy-bot: deploy 1835000055: created namespace redwood-nrt1, applied nodeSelector region=nrt1.

alex: can someone validate model-serving warmup? need the p95 numbers under 200ms to proceed.

maya: running 1k short prompts against 7B on A100 now. will post aggregated numbers in 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir: small gotcha — the T4s default to 1500 MTU on our cloud account. changed to 9000 and re-probed. documenting step in runbook.

ioana: gating rubric for handoff to SRE/product:
1) infra smoke green ✅
2) app smoke green ✅
3) SLOs met for 1h during steady traffic ✅
4) cost within expected bound (<= 120% budget estimate)
5) security review (image signing + private registry access) ✅
6) one-month capacity projection + autoscale policy attached

raj: for canary rollout plan:
- day0: pilot pool active, internal QA only
- day1: 5% traffic for 24h (monitor p50/p95, error rate, cost)
- day2: 20% traffic if stable
- day3: 100% for dedicated dev traffic if no regressions

maya: results for warmup: p50=28ms, p95=165ms, tail retries < 0.3% across 1k runs. KV cache hit=64%. passing SLO gate.

alex: excellent. next steps — schedule handoff meeting with SRE and product for 14:00 JST. leaving checklist here for final sign-offs.

ops-bot: reminder configured -> please post final sign-off message with tags: #infra-ready #nrt1 and add approvers: @raj @ioana @maya.

ioana: final sign-off: infra smoke ✅, app smoke ✅, perf SLOs ✅, security quick-pass ✅. @raj can you confirm cost acceptance?

raj: confirmed. cost within pilot budget and autoscale configured to spin down preemptibles on sustained high eviction. sign-off: ✅.

alex: handoff complete. creating follow-up ticket for 7-day post-launch health checks and cost ops review. thanks team :rocket:
